hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Which is the largest continent by area?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which is the largest continent by area? A. Africa. B. Asia. C. Europe. D. North America.

questions.question: Which is the largest country by area?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Which is the largest country by area? A. Canada. B. China. C. Russia. D. United States.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain above sea level?
questions.question_speech: Question three. Which is the highest mountain above sea level? A. Mount Everest. B. K2. C. Kilimanjaro. D. Mont Blanc.

questions.question: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which is the largest hot desert in the world? A. Gobi. B. Arabian. C. Kalahari. D. Sahara.

questions.question: How many continents are there?
questions.question_speech: Question five. How many continents are there? A. Five. B. Six. C. Seven. D. Eight.

questions.question: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.question_speech: Question six. What is the capital of Morocco? A. Casablanca. B. Rabat. C. Marrakesh. D. Fez.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. What is the capital of Australia? A. Sydney. B. Melbourne. C. Canberra. D. Perth.

questions.question: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. What is the capital of Canada? A. Ottawa. B. Toronto. C. Vancouver. D. Montreal.

questions.question: Which is the smallest country in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. Which is the smallest country in the world? A. Monaco. B. Malta. C. San Marino. D. Vatican City.

questions.question: Which country is shaped like a boot?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. Which country is shaped like a boot? A. Spain. B. Greece. C. Italy. D. Portugal.

questions.question: Which is the largest island in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Which is the largest island in the world? A. Madagascar. B. Greenland. C. Borneo. D. Iceland.

questions.question: Which river flows through Paris?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which river flows through Paris? A. The Seine. B. The Rhine. C. The Danube. D. The Thames.

questions.question: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia? A. Atlantic Ocean. B. Pacific Ocean. C. Indian Ocean. D. Arctic Ocean.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: On which continent is Egypt located?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. On which continent is Egypt located? A. Asia. B. Europe. C. South America. D. Africa.

questions.question: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. What is the capital of Japan? A. Osaka. B. Tokyo. C. Kyoto. D. Nagoya.
